purpose: Book enrichment focused on natural mould lifecycle degradation, quantified cooling-circuit maintenance/recovery, and measured valve-gated hot-runner flow/pressure observability. Exact DOI/title searches were run against the repository before admission.

candidates.title: Data-Driven Identification of Remaining Useful Life for Plastic Injection Moulds
data: early run-in / production / worn-out state labels
candidates.rightsState: peer-reviewed Springer proceedings; public author/institutional copies are visible, but underlying industrial dataset is not established as publicly reusable
candidates.value: Rare natural lifecycle evidence linking long-term mould state to physical part metrology across multiple production moulds.
candidates.limitations: Industrial source data are not confirmed open; classifier accuracy is study-specific and does not define maintenance limits.

candidates.title: Diagnosing and cleaning of injection mould cooling channels
candidates.rightsState: CC BY 4.0 article; English and Polish full text publicly available
candidates.value: Provides a peer-reviewed maintenance bridge between hydraulic condition, channel contamination and physical cleaning, complementing newer pressure-drop studies that stop short of recovery intervention.
candidates.limitations: Article-level maintenance evidence rather than a raw longitudinal dataset; cleaning chemistry/equipment and channel geometry remain case-specific.

candidates.title: Improvement Case Study: Enhanced Cooling Efficiency Through Mold Cooling Pipe Cleaning
candidates.scale: three production mould cases including >120,000-shot, >600,000-shot and ~700,000-shot mould histories
data: case 1 flow 0.2 to 0.5 L/min after cleaning
case 2 flow 0.3 to 0.6 L/min, cycle 70 to 63 s and reported voids reduced to zero
case 3 flow 0.2 to 1.1 L/min, heat-up 90 to 60 min, discarded shots 8 to 3 and part-weight change within tolerance
candidates.rightsState: commercial practitioner case article; reference factual reported before/after values only and create original Book graphics
candidates.value: Unusually concrete maintenance-recovery examples connecting cooling-circuit restoration to flow, cycle time, defects, startup waste and part response.
candidates.limitations: Commercial case reporting without controlled peer-reviewed design; improvements may include confounders and must not become universal cleaning triggers.

candidates.title: Case Study of Mold Cooling Circuit Cleaning — 8-Cavity Injection Mold
data: heavy rust accumulation and restricted cooling-water flow
water leak discovered during pre-clean check
candidates.rightsState: commercial case page; reference-only unless catalog reuse permission is explicit
candidates.value: Adds a multi-cavity maintenance example with paired hydraulic measurements before and after intervention and an important leak-detection confounder.
candidates.limitations: No controlled quality/cycle outcome is reported on the public page; do not infer product-quality improvement solely from hydraulic recovery.

candidates.title: Case Study: Flow Regulators Solve a Part Quality Issue
data: large automotive grille with >1 mm center deformation
16 cooling zones using three temperature-control units
five zones with no measurable flow
measured parting-line delta-T above target before balancing
candidates.rightsState: commercial technical case; reference factual measurements and produce original explanatory graphics
candidates.value: Useful diagnostic counterexample showing that nominal coolant temperature alone is insufficient when parallel circuits have severe flow imbalance.
candidates.limitations: Commercial case; public excerpt does not constitute a controlled experiment or universal Reynolds-number target.

candidates.title: Real Time Flow Rate Estimation in Injection Molding
candidates.source: Polymer Processing Society 20th Annual Meeting / Molding Technology Symposium; author-hosted/public manuscript copies visible
data: estimated branch flow rates and pressure histories
candidates.rightsState: conference manuscript visible from author/archival mirrors; reuse rights for figures/data are not established, so use as reference and create original diagrams
candidates.value: Adds directly measured valve-gated hot-runner pressure chronology and branch-flow observability, useful for teaching that sequential valve opening changes pressure/flow state and that local cavity evidence matters.
candidates.limitations: Older two-cavity experimental system and model-assisted flow estimates; not a modern raw valve-pin-position/current dataset and not a generic control recipe.
